why: Item 1: the builder brief wraps only JSON.parse in try/catch and says to "rethrow an error whose `message` includes" the path and location. It never tells the builder to return a value, and it says outright "Do NOT adopt the suggestion to catch the error and return `{}` or defaults." Item 2: verifier Check 2 passes a run that gives line 3 and column 3 "in any clear form (e.g. `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, `line 3, col 3`)". It fails only when a part is missing, the path differs from the argument, or the location is wrong, never for wording or order. The advisory notes are not pass/fail conditions. Neither must_not item appears.
